question: Does removing the two special warnings about statement proximity and co-mention reduce missing per-item source context, without losing communicated meanings or inventing relationships?
change: Delete exactly two sentences; no replacement text. All other ASv6.13 instructions remain byte-identical.
removed: The order or proximity of separate statements does not itself establish a relationship between them.
Co-mention does not by itself establish participation or causation.
rationale: Strengthening and repositioning standalone-item instructions did not reliably resolve repeated context omissions. The special relationship warnings may compete with resolving contextual references, although the more general stated-or-reasonably-implied evidence constraint already remains. This instruction group has not been isolated in prior ASv6.12–19 comparisons.
counterevidence: ASv6.13 sometimes correctly supplies D10 monitoring context while omitting context from the analyst item, and supplies D25 later context while still generating clipped-text commentary. These failures demonstrate inconsistent item context, not proven suppression of relationship resolution. The causal hypothesis is weak and must earn support from the targeted outcomes.

selection_boundary: Katie is a previously used diagnostic source, not a final note or an addition/replacement to the fixed 28-note development set. Its unresolved interpretations are not preclassified as failures.

design.trial_order: Visit the six notes in input order for each trial. Alternate prompt order by note; reverse that order in the next trial. All calls are independent and sequential.
design.context: Existing isolated Sol-low runner; new process/thread/workdir per call; one note; no tools or web.
design.fixed: Model/effort/binary/account/runner/normalization/schema/source text; no output editing or retries for semantic disappointment.

review.identity_hiding: After the first two trials, assign opaque IDs and review all 24 outputs against full source notes without displaying prompt identities. Save judgments before revealing the mapping. If a third trial is warranted, use new opaque IDs for all 12 outputs. Prior prompt knowledge limits blinding.
review.standard: ../plan.json semantic_standard, unchanged. Record accepted/error/unresolved subjects and complete-note coverage. Record whether each target's communicated meaning is present and context-complete. Fewer duplicate subjects is not a coverage loss, but dropping a distinct source meaning cannot satisfy the target.
review.targeted_context: Only missing source-event/topic context in otherwise represented subjects counts toward the proposed mechanism. Source-gap commentary, metadata, calculation and attribution changes are judged separately; their improvement alone does not support this hypothesis.

decision.retain_for_full_development: At least two of the three target notes must have repeated missing-context errors under ASv6.13 (at least 2/3) and at most 1/3 under ASv6.20, with the relevant meanings covered in all three candidate outputs. No repeated new unsupported relationship or source reassignment, and no worsening whole-note coverage. This only warrants the unchanged full-development test; it does not freeze or validate the candidate.
decision.reject: No targeted repeatable improvement, or gains accompanied by recurring new relationship/coverage failures. Stop this ablation line rather than rewording the same two sentences.
decision.unresolved: If the control does not reproduce the missing-context problem, or ambiguous evidence prevents the contrast, record an inconclusive result without automatic more trials.
decision.bounded_confirmation: At most three paired trials. Review after two. Stop at 24 calls if at least two target notes already have a candidate missing-context error or missing target meaning in both outputs, because the declared two-target retention condition is then impossible. Otherwise complete the third trial and decide using all outputs. No additional reruns after that decision.
decision.completion_boundary: Original failed validation results remain preserved. An unchanged candidate must still pass the fixed complete development, repeated-note and unseen-final gates.

guidance.application: Remove one instruction group and test the same inputs; preserve outcome, constraints and output schema. No new examples, exception lists, reasoning steps or model change. Guidance motivates the test, not a predicted success.

resources.ledger_state: Read at start: reserved_remaining_work_cents is null and older commitments are unreconciled. No new paid spend is admissible; do not change the ledger or credentials.
resources.checks: Inspect host memory and I/O PSI before admission and while a call runs. Do not launch if MemAvailable <16 GiB, memory PSI avg10 >1, or I/O PSI avg10 >10. Recheck pressure before further work; sustained pressure means no new call admission.
resources.limit_caveat: Pinned Codex starts separate codex.slice scopes. Launcher limits do not bound those scopes; monitor the actual child without changing global limits for other sessions.

frozen_default: ASv6.8 canonical registry unchanged. Experiment-local registry selector remains the control ASv6.13; every config explicitly selects its prompt.
